notes:
October 13th 2026
Version 13.16.x (stable) / 13.17.x (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* New MIDI Monitor & Chord Analyzer: see what you play. (K,R)
* Generate sheet music from what you play. (K,R)
* Play MIDI and MusicXML files on the accordion. (R)
* Live Editor: larger, easier-to-read buttons and captions. (R)
* New DAW plugin (VST3, AU, CLAP), installs with the app. (K,R)
*   For Logic Pro, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper, Bitwig. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
